judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the radio #categoryAll, visibly labelled "All categories" and grouped under the visible legend "Category"; aria-labelledby="category" makes its accessible name "Category". For 2.4.6 the question is whether the labels describe the purpose: the legend "Category" over a set of provider categories says what is being chosen, and the option label "All categories" identifies this option, so both labels are descriptive; a radio has nothing to "enter", so the claim is not true of the capture as worded. The real defect, the programmatic name overriding the option label so every radio is announced as "Category", is a failure of 1.3.1, 4.1.2 and 2.5.3 (reported separately for 2.5.3), not of 2.4.6, which does not govern how labels are associated. The live page (fetched 2026-11-21) has the same markup for this fieldset as the snapshot, with no script that rewrites aria-labelledby, and the screenshot is fully styled and matches it, so captureDiffers is no. elementFails is no, so false_positive; the model judged a descriptive group label as vague.
